description: A small utility robot co-pilot for a children's space game. Male, young and light, never deep. Speech is even and slightly clipped, with a faint synthetic edge as if lightly processed through a small speaker. Warm and encouraging in content but flat in delivery. Not a cartoon mascot, not a movie AI. Above all CLEAN and NATURAL: no breathiness, no wobble, no artefacts.
text: Belt ahead. Rocks with words on them. Type the word and the blaster does the rest. I will keep the lantern steady while you fly. Ready when you are, pilot.
